result.response:
I have completed the visual redesign for the Polymarket Pulse app. All data bindings, API interactions, and business logic have been strictly preserved. I applied a cohesive styling system using Tailwind v4 (CSS only) to deliver the trading-terminal feel.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Unified Dark Theme**: 
   - I refactored [globals.css](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/globals.css) and completely removed the light mode (`prefers-color-scheme: dark`) overrides and the Arial font reset to fix the "White band bug".
   - Set the root background to `#0B1120` (deep navy-ink) and applied `color-scheme: dark` to style the native scrollbars.

2. **Navigation Component ([Navigation.tsx](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/components/Navigation.tsx))**:
   - Extracted the links into a new client-side component to accurately compute the active route.
   - Restyled the nav to use the electric cyan-blue accent for the active tab pill. 
   - Updated the global header in [layout.tsx](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/layout.tsx) with a sticky backdrop-blur effect.

3. **Dashboard Stat Cards**:
   - Replaced plain borders with a subtle gradient accent glow at the top, colored according to the metric type (Cyan for Users, Emerald for Trades, Amber for Big Bets).
   - Applied `tabular-nums` and larger typography constraints for the values to ensure vertical alignment of digits.

4. **Data Tables & Filters**:
   - Across all pages ([`/`](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/page.tsx), [`/users`](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/users/page.tsx), [`/users/[wallet]`](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/users/%5Bwallet%5D/page.tsx), [`/leaderboard`](file:///Users/nersibayat/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/polymarket-pulse/src/app/leaderboard/page.tsx)): Rebuilt headers as sticky (`sticky top-0 z-10 bg-[#0B1120]/80 backdrop-blur`), right-aligned all numbers, added `tabular-nums` to every numerical data cell.
   - Increased border contrast and added zebra/hover striping to rows for readability (`hover:bg-[#1E2939]/80 group`). 
   - Transformed simple badges into trading-style pill labels (BUY in emerald, SELL in rose).
   - Inputs in the filters bar were modified to clearly distinguish borders (`border-slate-700`) and correctly emphasize a cyan-blue ring `focus:ring-[#38BDF8]` on focus.

### Quality Gates Validation

- `npm run build` completed successfully with zero errors.
- `npx vitest run` confirmed all existing tests still pass.
- No new dependencies were introduced (I explicitly avoided adding `clsx` or animation libraries, keeping it entirely vanilla Next.js + Tailwind v4).
- `grep -n "prefers-color-scheme"` confirms that the light mode toggle class overriding the background is completely eliminated.
